sources.name: foundation
sources.mode: canonical gateway and REST BFF processes, real PostgreSQL identity repository, real OPA
interfaces: canonical delegated Passport facade with CAS headers
sources.authority_boundary: Passport ownership is external; BFF must delegate lifecycle and must not fall back on upstream failure.

sources.name: passport
sources.mode: canonical standalone service with explicit durable reference patch; same host OS as fenced executor
sources.authority_boundary: one active aggregate passport, signed exact scopes, durable authority revisions, authenticated CAS mutation; signed historical operation receipts reconcile a local intent without restoring past authority

sources.name: ledger
sources.mode: unchanged canonical service with real PostgreSQL
sources.authority_boundary: records assertions; does not authorize actions or prove their truth

sources.name: cascade
sources.mode: canonical in-process module, not a substitute service
sources.authority_boundary: eligibility only; demo-three-pass profile is a bounded behavior fixture, not statistical adequacy

sources.name: gcl
sources.mode: canonical deterministic FalsificationGate in isolated local subprocess; network disabled
sources.authority_boundary: advisory constraint check; never authority or independent outcome evidence

source_reconstruction: fresh pinned upstream + verified complete patches
limits: Reproduces source inputs and dependencies; does not claim byte-identical release, clean external host, or second-person validation.
